title: Support ticket, email and message triage
description: Route one customer ticket, email or chat message to a team and flag urgency, refund, churn or frustration

text.description: the ticket, email or chat message as written

teams.description: label and description of each team; 'other' is added

profile.description: strict asks dept, refund, churn; full also asks urgent and frustration (frustration >= 1.5 escalates)

dept.instructions: Which team should own this ticket?

extra.other: anything else, or too vague to tell

refund.instructions: Is the customer asking for money back (a refund or a credit)?

churn.instructions: Is the customer threatening to cancel or leave?

dept.instructions: Which team should own this ticket?

extra.other: anything else, or too vague to tell

urgent.instructions: Does this need attention today (outage, money lost, deadline, or a blocked customer)?

refund.instructions: Is the customer asking for money back (a refund or a credit)?

churn.instructions: Is the customer threatening to cancel or leave?

combine: escalate if churn >= churn_escalate; escalate if frustration >= frustration_escalate; human_review if dept == 'other'; human_review if dept.p < route_p; human_review if grey(refund) or grey(churn) or grey(urgent); route otherwise

priority.combine: urgent if urgent >= yes_at; normal otherwise

refund_flag.combine: yes if refund >= yes_at; unsure if grey(refund); no otherwise

limitations: single-label (ask one noul per department for multi-label)
English plus one German case; tone reads are a sample of 3 cases
route on dept only; priority comes from the flags (priority and refund_flag outputs)
the intent and email-tray variants and the reply flag are not built: the question set is fixed per profile
a mailbox or ticket export is a batch job over the same questions, not one recipe call per row
notes: # deviation: spec 5.1: teams is a required array of {label, description} (the engine applies no schema defaults); the default profile `strict` asks the three questions of the verified u01 request (dept, refund, churn) and `full` adds urgent and frustration; flags and frustration are chosen by profile, not as inputs; escalation is by churn and frustration, urgency is the `priority` output; the intent and email variants are not built
